text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to present the golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I want to carve your name into history.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
May the true light shine upon you, forever 
and ever.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: May it shower down upon you—

text_block_list.name: Bouquet & Eye
text_block_list.text: Yaaaah!! Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa!? What crazy intensity! Was 
Bouquet always like that!?

text_block_list.name: Race Enthusiast
text_block_list.text:
I remember when she first debuted. She 
seemed like such a quiet girl, but—haha! 
...So, it's for her Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Race Enthusiast
text_block_list.text: What a strong girl she is.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Win, win—! I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Bouquet Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Go for it, Bouquet!" "Seize your dream!" 
"Run!" "Bring victory home to your 
Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Ngggh, I'll—!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She has brilliantly proven she's the 
strongest! Almond Eye...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I won, I won...! This victory is mine!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She never yielded the summit! Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Ai's Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the greatest race ever! 
You'll be the strongest forever and 
always, Eye-chan! Congratulations!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
So that's Almond Eye at her absolute 
peak...! She's truly incredible! But the 
other runners did great too. Especially 
Curren Bouquetd'or!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaaah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't... reach them—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I'm... so sorry. I— I let the flower of 
victory slip away...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: The "Golden Bouquet" is...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I point behind her as she hangs her head 
dejectedly--

text_block_list.name: Bouquet Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet and Trainer, that was so close!" 
"Now I'm even more excited for what's to 
come!" "Great work!" "You're definitely 
the leading star of the next era, 
Bouquet!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
choice_data_list:
Let's keep walking forward together with 
everyone from now on.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Everyone—! Thank you so much... for 
placing your hopes and dreams upon us...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The ones who led us to this stage are all 
of you—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Echoing from the stands were praise, 
appreciation, and high expectations for 
the futureâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of these three years, where she 
ran forward staying true to herself, what 
awaited her was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a beautiful sight.
choice_data_list:
I'm sure I was able to receive that golden 
bouquet.
I'm sure I received a golden bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victory had slipped away. But what rests 
in my arms now— is unequivocally a grand 
bouquet of gold, bound together by the 
journey of these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaah!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...No, absolutely not—!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain I received it too. The 
one-and-only radiance you bestowed upon 
me――!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet was strong in the race of the 
century too~!" "I wonder what Curren 
Bouquetd'or will run next?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Everyone's completely fallen for 
her charm, haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I still want to keep growing. I want to 
beat you again...! These feelings inside 
me just won't stop overflowing...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you, Bouquet-chan. Let's run 
together again, definitely!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The front page of the sports paper 
proclaimed with lively excitement:

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The battle of the century, centered 
around the queen of the era, Almond Eye, 
has begun—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Alongside her rivals, it was a brilliant, 
dream-filled race that deserves to be 
remembered for generations to come."
